title: Large quadratic class-group completion
objective: Replace bounded exhaustive real-quadratic candidate scanning with an exact compact class-cycle implementation and preserve explicit resource/proof routing

oracles: Sage/PARI exact quadratic class and narrow class groups

handoff.summary: Real quadratic class-number requests now stream an exact divisor-based reduced-form enumeration and count complete rho cycles without constructing invariant factors, generators, subgroup tables, or class lists. The same exact path supplies a public narrow_class_number method. The D=10000001 benchmark returns h=1 and h+=2 from 4408 forms with constant-memory class handling, agreeing with Sage/PARI and Magma.
risks: Full large real quadratic class-group and narrow-class-group invariant factors still materialize representatives inside the bounded quadratic-forms backend; a narrow relation/BSGS backend remains future work.

The pure Python Sage.js stream is exact but takes about 13.6 seconds for ordinary plus narrow D=10000001 on this Linux x64 host; source-transparent native lowering or modular-root enumeration would be the next performance step.
The lane-required pnpm test:native and exact-SHA non-Linux platform receipts are intentionally deferred to central integration; no native boundary or dependency changed.
next_steps: Cherry-pick the coherent implementation commit onto current main and run pnpm test:native plus exact-SHA Windows x64, Linux arm64, and macOS arm64 focused validation.
Implement a narrow Buchmann--McCurley/BSGS presentation backend before claiming unbounded narrow invariant-factor support.
